text:
lena: Heads up — noticing a spike in KMS wrap/unwrap failures from prod audit logs starting ~09:12 UTC. Counts are high and correlated with a new service account we onboarded yesterday. tagging @omar @kevin :eyes:
omar: thanks. can you paste the exact log snippet and the SA email?
lena: sure, snippet below (redacted):
```
{ "timestamp": "2026-03-23T09:12:45Z", "event": "kms.wrap_failure", "key": "projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/prod/cryptoKeys/llm-wrap", "principal": "svc-onboarder@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com", "error": "insufficient_entropy" }
```
kevin: hmm, "insufficient_entropy" looks like KMS rejecting a wrapping operation due to low entropy from client side or an unsupported wrapping algorithm. could also be a bug in the client library we shipped.
olivia: we rolled out that onboarding agent yesterday — it uses a custom wrapper flow. devops-bot, did that rollout touch the prod KMS key policy?
devops-bot: rollout #onboard-agent v2.1 deployed to prod at 2026-03-23T08:50Z. No KMS key policy changes in that deployment.
omar: OK. next steps to triage: (1) confirm service account activity + caller IPs, (2) test wrap/unwrap with that SA in a staging key with same policy, (3) capture a request/response with full headers. I can take 1 and 2 now.
lena: assigning 1 & 3 to @omar, 2 to @kevin. please update here when you have repro or it's cleared.
kevin: will repro locally with the onboarding agent binary. quick test command:
```
# simulate wrap with SA
gcloud kms keys versions list --location=global --keyring=prod --key=llm-wrap
# then run wrapper: ./onboarder --wrap --key=projects/redwood... --sa=svc-onboarder@...
```
omar: I pulled recent audit logs, caller IPs are internal infra subnets — looks legitimate. Creating a staging key and will run the agent against it. timeline: 30m.
lena: also enabling more verbose KMS audit export to BigQuery for the next 2 hours (to catch any additional error context). security-bot, flag if wrap_failure events > 100 in next hour.
security-bot: alert rule created: kms.wrap_failure > 100/hr (scope: prod). will notify #incidents if threshold crossed.
kevin: quick note — if it's client entropy, workaround is to switch agent to OS RNG instead of a concatted PRNG we used in v2.1. I'll try that in the repro.
omar: repro against staging key succeeded (wrap/unwrap fine) with same SA credentials. that narrows it to environment or ephemeral network issue in prod.
olivia: could prod environment be using an old openssl or FIPS-mode container that affects RNG? infra team, any recent base image changes?
kevin: checking. we bumped base image to debian-12-slim yesterday in a subset of hosts (image-id: rwood-deb12-2026-03-22). FIPS not enabled at packaging time.
len a: OK — items: 1) kevin to test agent switch to OS RNG and produce a patch if it fixes (ETA 2h). 2) omar to instrument prod host RNG health check and add a one-off cron to rotate agent process if entropy pool low (ETA 1h). 3) olivia to file infra ticket to bisect recent base image rollout (ETA 4h).
omar: also recommending immediate rotation of the llm-wrap key if we see persistent wrap failures + any failed-requests with odd error codes. not rotating yet — will wait for reproduction or additional failure signatures.
kevin: created a small branch that toggles RNG — linking: https://github.com/redwood/onboarder/compare/fix/rng-oss. I'll run it in staging and report.
olivia: thanks. I'll add this to the daily security sync and pull in oncall if threshold triggers. :thumbsup:
lena: great. last bit — please make sure we log the rotation plan steps in the ticket and capture who approves key rotation. we want an audit trail.
omar: noted. will open ticket SEC-TRIAGE-482 and paste repros + decision matrix.
kevin: staging patch passed. if prod still fails after agent restart and RNG switch, plan B is a key rotation and rollback of v2.1.
lena: perfect. keep updates short here. thanks all. :white_check_mark:
